headers: keep sb./sth. in order 使…守规矩；维持秩序
maintain order 维持治安/秩序
restore order 恢复秩序
rows: The administrative staff worked hard to keep the crowd in order during the busy charitable auction. 行政人员在繁忙的慈善拍卖会期间努力维持人群秩序。
Police were called in to maintain order after the protest turned violent. 抗议活动演变成暴力冲突后，警方被调来维持秩序。
It took several days for the government to restore order in the flood-affected regions. 政府花了几天时间才在受灾地区恢复秩序。
